newsitem.title: UK: Stan Chartered down on mild profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Stan Chartered down on mild profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Plc fell eight pence to 885 as light profit-taking continued after a solid bull run in the preceding two weeks.
Standard Chartered had powered ahead since Feberuary 25 to climb to a 900 pence peak on March 9.
"You cannot go up forever. We're seeing some profit-taking now, but the undertone remains good," said one market maker.
Standard Chartered was one of few stocks in the banking sector to trade below Monday's close. Barclays was the sector's best performer, up 19 pence at 1,131, after having lagged since mid-February.
The group on February 16 reported full-year results at the low end of analysts' expectations.
